# Planning-docs components — brainstorm

Filemark's original problem: brainstorms / specs / plans live in
markdown, but *visualization* is always the weak point. Datagrid was
the first structural component to fix that. This doc enumerates what
else belongs — grouped by the planning-doc shape it serves, then tiered
by value × effort.

- **Opened:** 2026-04-23
- **Audience:** self + future AI sessions
- **Status:** ideation — nothing committed; each component is a
  concrete, build-ready spec when the time comes to pick.
- **Feeds into:** `ROADMAP.md` (§10 non-goals + the pillars list); when
  one of these is picked, copy its work items into `TASKS.md`.

---

## 1. Time-oriented

| Component | Signal |
|---|---|
| **Timeline** | horizontal events, dates on x-axis, labels/lanes for owners. Roadmap at a glance |
| **Gantt** | timeline + dependencies + durations; bars span day-ranges |
| **Calendar heatmap** | GitHub-style activity grid — great for streaks, cadence |
| **Burndown** | remaining vs time, shows if a milestone will slip |
| **Roadmap swimlane** | teams as rows, quarters as columns |

## 2. Status / task

| Component | Signal |
|---|---|
| **Kanban** | drag-column board from a CSV (`group-by=status`) |
| **Progress tracker** | weighted checklist with % complete |
| **Status pipeline** | linear stages with a moving head (like deploy stages) |
| **Milestone card** | single milestone w/ deadline, owner, progress, risks |

## 3. Decision / analysis

| Component | Signal |
|---|---|
| **2×2 matrix** | prioritization (impact × effort), risk × probability. Drop items into quadrants |
| **SWOT grid** | four-cell strategic analysis |
| **Decision tree** | branching logic; click branches to reveal detail |
| **ADR block** | Architecture Decision Record (status, context, decision, consequences) |
| **Pros/cons** | dual-column trade-off list w/ weights |
| **Comparison table** | options × criteria w/ ✓/✗/value |
| **RACI matrix** | people × tasks (Responsible/Accountable/Consulted/Informed) |

## 4. Data viz (reuses datagrid's `parseCSV` + columns/rows)

| Component | Signal |
|---|---|
| **Chart** | bar / line / pie / scatter / area. `<Chart type="bar" src="./metrics.csv" x="month" y="users" />` |
| **Stat cards grid** | row of KPI cards (value + label + delta) |
| **Sparkline row** | small-multiples of the existing inline sparkline type, scaled up |
| **Funnel** | conversion stages, drop-off visualization |

## 5. People / journeys

| Component | Signal |
|---|---|
| **Persona card** | photo/initials + role + goals/pain points |
| **User journey map** | stages × thoughts/feelings/actions lanes |
| **Org / team tree** | hierarchy |
| **Stakeholder map** | 2×2 of influence × interest |

## 6. Spec-oriented

| Component | Signal |
|---|---|
| **Feature matrix** | feature rows × plan/tier columns (yes/no/value) |
| **Requirements list** | FR/NFR with status, priority, acceptance criteria |
| **Glossary** | defined-term index with search/anchor links |
| **FAQ accordion** | polished `<Details>` grouped collapsibles |
| **Risk register** | risk × probability × impact × mitigation |

## 7. Enrichment / polish

| Component | Signal |
|---|---|
| **Embed** | safe iframe for Loom/YouTube/Excalidraw/Figma |
| **Quote card** | styled pull-quote w/ attribution |
| **Callout variants** | already have — add `question`, `example`, `quote` |
| **Anchor tag cloud** | `#tag` index across the doc |

---

## Tiered recommendation

### Tier 1 — biggest lift, build first (each ≤ 1–2 days on top of existing infra)

1. ✅ **Chart** — `<Chart type="bar|line|pie|scatter|area" src="./x.csv" x="…" y="…" />`. Reuses datagrid's CSV parser + type inference. Single biggest visual upgrade for any quantitative doc. **Shipped 2026-04-23** (bar / line / pie / area / scatter / funnel / radar).
2. ✅ **Kanban** — `<Kanban src="./tasks.csv" group-by="status" card-fields="title,owner,priority" />`. Thin renderer on top of parseCSV — lanes are distinct values, cards are rows. **Shipped 2026-04-23** (read-only — filemark is a reader, users edit CSV + auto-refresh re-renders).
3. **Timeline** — `<Timeline src="./milestones.csv" start="date" end="date?" label="title" lane="team?" />`. Horizontal axis, lanes, event dots/bars. Zoom + pan like Mermaid has.
4. ✅ **Stat card grid** — `<Stats>` containing `<Stat title="…" value="…" delta="…" />`. **Shipped 2026-04-23.** CSV-driven variant stays deferred in backlog.
5. ✅ **ADR block** — `<ADR status="proposed|accepted|superseded" date="…">` with free-form markdown body (conventional Context / Decision / Consequences H3s). **Shipped 2026-04-23.** Five statuses, supersedes/superseded-by links.
6. **2×2 matrix** — `<Matrix x-axis="Effort" y-axis="Impact">` wrapping `<Item x="0.8" y="0.3">Launch …</Item>` or auto-positioning from a CSV. Classic brainstorm tool.

### Tier 2 — structural, each ~2–4 days

7. **Gantt** — enhance beyond Mermaid's built-in; date-range bars from CSV, dependencies as arrows, critical path highlight.
8. **Progress tracker** — weighted checklist + bar; persists via StorageAdapter.
9. **Comparison table** — options × criteria, `✓` / `✗` / values, highlight winners. Specialization of datagrid or its own component.
10. **FAQ / accordion cluster** — polish of `<Details>` with search/expand-all.
11. **Calendar heatmap** — `<Heatmap src="./activity.csv" date="day" value="commits" />`.

### Tier 3 — power / niche, when the need surfaces

12. SWOT grid, RACI matrix, Risk register (structured tables with a specialized layout — not strictly necessary; can approximate with datagrid today).
13. Decision tree, User journey map, Stakeholder map.
14. Persona card, Funnel, Embed safe-iframe.
15. Glossary (with search + anchor linking to defined terms).

---

## First-slice pitch (≤ 1 week)

Four components cover ~80% of planning-doc shapes:

- **Chart** — every metric doc.
- **Kanban** — every task / roadmap doc.
- **Stat card** — every summary doc.
- **ADR block** — every decision doc.

All share the existing authoring conventions (fenced blocks or `<Tag>`
components with info-string-grammar flags). Chart + Kanban both reuse
`@filemark/datagrid`'s CSV parser + column-type inference, so the
marginal infra cost is small.

---

## Open questions before picking

1. **Scope framing** — are planning docs primarily
   (a) prose-with-sprinkled-data (→ Chart + Kanban + Stat cards), or
   (b) structured-spec-with-standard-sections (→ ADR + Requirements +
   RACI + Glossary)? The first three components look very different
   from the second three.
2. **Authoring surface** — fenced blocks (`\`\`\`kanban src=…`) or
   component tags (`<Kanban …/>`)? Tag is more MDX-ish, fence is more
   markdown-native. Both work; pick a default per component.
3. **Drag / edit interactions** — should Kanban let you drag cards
   between columns (writes to `StorageAdapter`, never touches the CSV
   file)? Or read-only visualization only?
4. **Chart library** — `recharts` (React-native, ~50 KB), `chart.js`
   + react wrapper (~30 KB + 40 KB), or hand-rolled SVG (minimal deps,
   more work)? Recharts is ergonomic but the biggest bundle;
   handrolled is cleanest but takes a day per chart type.
5. **Interop** — should chart be able to read data from the same
   `./foo.csv` that a datagrid already reads (pointing at the same
   file from two components)? If yes, cache the parsed CSV keyed by
   path inside `@filemark/datagrid` (or `@filemark/csv` when that
   package lands).

---

## How to use this doc

- Add new component ideas under the appropriate pillar.
- When a component is picked for build, copy its bullet + spec notes
  into `TASKS.md` as a concrete milestone.
- When shipped, move the line to the "Shipped" column in
  `ROADMAP.md` §1 and delete the detail here.
- Prune anything that hasn't moved in 3 months — not actually wanted.

## Component plans — live

- [`CHART_PLAN.md`](./CHART_PLAN.md) — `@filemark/chart` (bar / line /
  pie / area via recharts). **Shipped 2026-04-23.** Technical
  reference: [`CHART.md`](./CHART.md). Internal architecture:
  [`packages/chart/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../../chrome-extensions/filemark/packages/chart/ARCHITECTURE.md).
- [`KANBAN.md`](./KANBAN.md) — `@filemark/kanban` (CSV → board, read-only).
  **Shipped 2026-04-23.** Plan: [`KANBAN_PLAN.md`](./KANBAN_PLAN.md).
- [`STATS_ADR.md`](./STATS_ADR.md) — `<Stats>` / `<Stat>` + `<ADR>` MDX
  layout components in `@filemark/mdx`. **Shipped 2026-04-23.**

## Related docs

- `ROADMAP.md` — pillar-level plan + sequencing.
- `DATAGRID.md` — technical reference for the first rich component.
- `ARCHITECTURE.md` §11 — rendering pipelines; each new component
  slots in the same `MDXViewer.components.*` or `components.code` lane.
- `AI_CONTEXT.md` — summary brief for new AI sessions.
